verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document scoped or least-privilege API keys for agents. The only related material is about meeting tokens for room participants ('manage tokens', and token properties such as start_cloud_recording). Those are room-access tokens, not scoped REST API credentials, so they are an adjacent feature that earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
